app.title: SID — Internal Documents
app.lead: The key links this plugin to your SID account. It carries the same permissions you have — treat it like a password.

settings.getKey: Where do I get the API key?
settings.getKeyHint: In SID open Profile → API keys and create one. It is shown only once.

notify.inAppDescription: A daily digest of updates and pending confirmations. E-mail is sent by SID itself.
